title: Scale bounded by field size
statement: Let $n,a,b$ be positive integers with $2a\le b$, and define $s=\lceil nb/a\rceil$ and $d=\max(1,\lceil\log_2 s\rceil)$, where the ceiling-log expression denotes the least natural number $k$ with $2^k\ge s$. Then $s\le 2^d$.
hypotheses_covered: Twice the bias numerator is at most the denominator
